title: SRD: crawling through Difficult Terrain pays the crawl foot and the Difficult Terrain foot (3 ft per foot); engine: a scene's Difficult Terrain applies only to mode 'walk', so crawling costs 2

history.summary: A scene's Difficult Terrain (game.scene.difficult) now applies to every mode that spends walking Speed (walk and crawl), not just mode 'walk'. Crawling through rubble therefore costs 3 ft per foot (R-42 Reading A). Climb, swim and fly are unchanged. The fix also makes T-98's red test pass (strict xpass).
